memory.description: [YOU] Core content of this memory. One self-contained statement: a raw message (type=msg), a session summary (type=summary), or one atomic fact (type=atom).

id.description: [SYSTEM] Unique identifier, auto-generated by the system. msg: 'session_{sid}_{i}'. atom: 'session_{sid}_{i}_{k}'. summary: 'session_{sid}_summary'.

type.description: [SYSTEM] msg: unprocessed input message, auto-set. summary: per-session summary. atom: an atomic, self-contained fact derived from messages.

time.description: [YOU] Temporal scope. Always include temporal information if present in the fact; do NOT drop dates, durations, or relative times. Must be SELF-CONTAINED: an absolute time ('7 May 2023') or a relative phrase that carries its own absolute anchor ('the week before 9 June 2023'). A bare relative word ('yesterday', 'last week') is NOT allowed. Match the source's granularity -- never invent finer precision ('last year' -> '2022', not a day). Use ISO 8601 for absolute points/ranges ('2026-09-14', '2026-09-01/2026-09-15'). Empty string '' when the fact carries no time.
examples: two days before Alan was born

role.description: [YOU] Speaker of this memory, by real name (e.g. 'Caroline', 'Melanie'). For type=msg this is the original speaker. For summary use 'summary'. For atom it is the speaker whose fact this is (who said or owns the fact).

tag.description: [YOU] Array of key-value labels. Free-form but keep the fixed key vocabulary: entity, topic, activity, action, event, state, sentiment, relation, time, other. Format: 'key:value'. May be empty when no useful label applies.

source.description: [SYSTEM] IDs of source memories for provenance. For type=msg this is empty (it is raw input). For atom it is the message id(s) the fact was derived from (e.g. ['session_1_3']). For summary it is the session's message ids.

changelog.description: [SYSTEM time + YOU content] Version history. Time auto-generated on modification. Content records previous memory value.
